seo.title: Orbit integration | Example Co
seo.description: Connect Orbit to Example Co in a few minutes. Records sync both ways, field mapping is set once, and duplicates are merged automatically.

openGraph.title: Orbit integration | Example Co
openGraph.description: Connect Orbit to Example Co in a few minutes. Records sync both ways, field mapping is set once, and duplicates are merged automatically.

slots.name: Heading
slots.content: Keep Orbit and Example Co in step

slots.name: Subhead
slots.content: Records written in either tool show up in the other within a minute, with the field mapping you choose once and never revisit.

images.alt: An Orbit record opening beside the matching Example Co record

sections.designSection: media walkthrough, media on the right

adaptation.notes: Mirrors the base layout: cards on the left, media on the right. Styles only, no prop or structure change. Created with create_variant, then set_variant_styles on the row flex-direction.

slots.name: Header/Body Copy
slots.content: Example Co watches for changes on both sides and writes the winning value back, so nobody has to reconcile a spreadsheet on Friday afternoon.

slots.name: Sidebar/Card Body
slots.content: An administrator connects the workspace once; everyone else signs in with their own account.

slots.name: heading
slots.content: Duplicates merged before anyone sees them

slots.name: body
slots.content: Matching rules run on every write, so a record created twice arrives once. Deleted records are archived rather than dropped.

images.alt: Two matching records merging into one

newComponentSpec.name: Setup steps section
newComponentSpec.description: Three numbered setup steps with an optional note under the last one; static content through props. Fills the gap between the walkthrough and the feature grid on integration pages.
structure: header block: Overline, Heading, Body Copy
ol.c-setupsteps with three li.c-setupsteps__li: span.c-setupsteps__li__num, heading (h3), paragraph

slots.name: Body Copy
slots.content: One admin approval, one connection, one test record.

slots.name: Step 1 - Body
slots.content: An Orbit administrator approves Example Co for the workspace.

slots.name: Step 2 - Body
slots.content: Accept the suggested mapping or change it. The mapping is saved with the connection, not with the person who made it.

slots.name: Step 3 - Body
slots.content: Create one record in Orbit and watch it appear on the Example Co side before you turn the sync on for everyone.

slots.name: Feature 1
slots.content: Two-way sync on records, notes, and owners.

slots.name: Feature 2
slots.content: Field mapping you set once and can change later.

slots.name: q1
slots.content: How long does the first sync take?

slots.name: a1
slots.content: Minutes for a small workspace, a few hours for a large one. Nothing is written until the first pass finishes.

slots.name: q2
slots.content: Can I sync in one direction only?

slots.name: a2
slots.content: Yes. Choose the direction per object when you map the fields.

slots.name: q3
slots.content: What happens when a record is deleted?

slots.name: a3
slots.content: It is archived on the other side rather than deleted, and can be restored for thirty days.

slots.name: q4
slots.content: Is there a limit on records?

slots.name: Body Copy
slots.content: Set it up once for the whole team. Nothing syncs until you say so.
